source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-TDRE75W1 / NS-TDRG75W1 Vented Dryer Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before accessing internal components.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service test mode entered. Continue with component checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After service test entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Service test screen 02 — knob lights
steps.body: Enter service test mode. Press Time Adjust + to screen 02. Turn cycle knob — indicator lights around knob should follow each detent.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter service test mode. Press Time Adjust + to screen 02. Turn cycle knob — indicator lights around knob should follow each detent.

steps.title: Knob indicator lights
steps.body: Does each knob position toggle the surrounding light on/off correctly?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Does each knob position toggle the surrounding light on/off correctly?

steps.title: Service test screen 03 — key check
steps.body: Press Time Adjust + to screen 03 (key checking mode). Press each touchpad key.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Time Adjust + to screen 03 (key checking mode). Press each touchpad key.

steps.title: All keys respond
steps.body: Does every control key register in key-check mode?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Does every control key register in key-check mode?

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace display/control panel or main PCB.

steps.title: Inspect CN9 harness
steps.body: Verify CN9 display communication harness; reseat connectors.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify CN9 display communication harness; reseat connectors.

steps.title: Replace UI or PCB
steps.oemOutcome: Replace display assembly or main PCB.

steps.title: HMI verified
steps.oemOutcome: Knob lights and keys pass service tests 02–03.
